scope: One offline DGA training/validation candidate; no reserved scoring or runtime promotion
training_partition: data/dga_evaluation_protocol.json:development_partitions.training; 69993 positive and 67715 benign scored first labels
validation_partition: data/dga_evaluation_protocol.json:development_partitions.validation_tuning; 80000 positive and 15236 benign scored first labels
predictive_features: ml.dga.tokens first-label character 2/3-grams with training-only TF-IDF and ml.dga.lexical_features ten numeric fields, in ml.dga.NUMERIC_FEATURES order
single_hypothesis: Upweight training-only benign labels that are alphabetic and at least 12 characters, because long alphabetic legitimate domains dominate false positives
additional_training_sample_weight: 3.0 for benign first labels with label.isalpha() and len(label) >= 12; 1.0 otherwise; multiply sklearn's balanced class weight in logistic fit; use same row weights for boosted fit
base_encoder: DictVectorizer + TfidfTransformer(sublinear_tf=True) + StandardScaler ten numeric fields + LogisticRegression(C=1.0,solver=liblinear,class_weight=balanced,max_iter=300,random_state=26145)
threshold_selection: among validation thresholds satisfying recall>=0.8, precision>=0.95, FPR<=0.02, choose highest recall then lowest FPR; if none pass, retain 0.99 and report failure; no second training configuration
candidate_output: ml/dga_weighted_candidate.json; always runtime_enabled=false with matching .sha256; never replace ml/dga_v2.json
reserved_evaluation: not materialized; no evaluation until a separate source manifest with integrity and overlap checks is frozen; leave candidate disabled if unavailable
